dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Joubert syndrome (autosomal recessive ciliopathy, confirmed by molar tooth sign on MRI and pathogenic variants in ciliopathy genes).

Differential diagnoses to consider:
1. COACH syndrome (Joubert syndrome with hepatic fibrosis and ocular coloboma)
2. Senior-Løken syndrome (Joubert syndrome with nephronophthisis)
3. Other ciliopathy with cerebellar vermis hypoplasia (e.g., CEP290-related disorder)
